notes:
Summary: Small-mid dev tools company building JetBrains plugins (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that ship with a local indexer + streaming code completions. Primary ask: low-latency completions in-editor (<50ms preferred for local suggestions), model/version pinning per workspace, offline-first behavior (index on developer machine), and enterprise controls for key management and audit.

Details / quotes: "We need the plugin to feel native — suggestions should appear as you type with near-zero lag. If cloud is down, plugin should keep serving from local index/model cache." — CTO.

Technical constraints: client-side incremental indexing (background), index size target <4GB per dev, tokenization and prefix cache on client, models executed on customer-dedicated/private cluster (not public hosted) with optional on-prem option. Wants ability to pin model revisions per repo and fallback policy to smaller quantized variant for low-latency edits.

Security / compliance: SSO (SAML), KMS integration for model keys, audit logging retention (1y), EU residency for some customers. Will require SOC2 + ISO27k paperwork for procurement.

Commercial: cost-sensitive — comparing reserved Dedicated vs on-prem license. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to control token costs.

Sales notes / tone: friendly, technically deep team. Key champion: Senior Plugin Engineer (Leads: Maria Chen). Procurement lead wants security pack and reference for JetBrains marketplace compliance.

POC goals: 1) end-to-end plugin prototype (local indexer + streaming completion) deployed to 5 internal devs; 2) SLA for latency <50ms for local completions, cold-start model load <2s; 3) security sign-off (SAML + KMS integration).
